method.extraction: Rendered source HTML heuristic: title, H1, meta description, canonical, H2 count, image count, unique same-origin path count, JSON-LD types, and lower-cased visible-text phrase counts after script/style/tag removal.
limits: These observations are correlational and do not establish ranking causality.
Raw HTML counts can include navigation, footer, accessibility, and repeated component text; they are comparison signals, not keyword-density targets.
More words, images, links, FAQs, or schema types are not automatically better and do not authorize copying a competitor.
External pages can change after the observed timestamp; the recorded SHA-256 is an observation receipt, not a permanent identity.
No forms, accounts, logins, reviews, GBP surfaces, community posts, or public mutations were used.
